content: scripts/route.py is an OpenRouter proxy system that routes tool calls through free AI models while enforcing strict data policies, consent rules, and comprehensive logging. It provides command-line interfaces for model probing, serving as a proxy for third-party tools, maintaining audit ledgers, checking document consent, and running automated self-tests. The module implements three critical safeguards: using only declared free models with zero pricing, verifying document consent before transmission, and recording every call for offline replay and auditing purposes. It additionally provides local multilingual embedding through a sentence transformer model since no free remote embedding models accept the data policy, while also handling caching, rate limiting, and cost prevention. Finally, it serves as a security layer that prevents exposure of real API keys by routing all calls through OpenRouter with data_collection=deny and using a single authenticated endpoint for third-party tool integration.
